channel.title: Paksh: Economy
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Lockheed Martin Acquires Nova Scotia Undersea Defence Firm
item.description: American aerospace and defense company Lockheed Martin has acquired Nova Scotia-based undersea defence company for $3.45 billion. The acquisition involves an undersea warfare company. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Trump claims progress on Canada trade deal
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has stated that he has "concepts of a very good deal" and the "concept of a deal" with Canada regarding trade. The specifics of these concepts or any potential agreement were not detailed in the coverage. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Gold Prices Decline Ahead of Federal Reserve Decision
item.description: Gold prices settled lower as markets awaited a decision from the Federal Reserve. Australian shares also edged lower, with miners retreating as the Reserve Bank of Australia's decision loomed. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Trane Technologies and BASF Report Strong Third-Quarter Earnings
item.description: Trane Technologies reported strong third-quarter results, raising its full-year revenue guidance while reaffirming its earnings per share guidance. Similarly, BASF lifted its full-year earnings outlook following a robust third quarter. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: China's Robot Makers Focus on AI After Mastering Manufacturing
item.description: Chinese robot manufacturers have achieved proficiency in the physical aspects of robot production and are now shifting their focus to developing the artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities, or 'brains,' of these machines. This marks the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: UPI Transactions Surge Past 25 Billion, Daily Value Exceeds Rs 1 Lakh Crore
item.description: Unified Payments Interface (UPI) transactions surpassed 25 billion in October, marking a new record. Concurrently, the average daily transaction value exceeded Rs 1 lakh crore for the first time. This growth in digital payments occurred… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: India's First Bullet Train: Speed, Capacity, and Design Details Emerge
item.description: Details have emerged regarding India's first bullet train, which is designed to reach a maximum test speed of 280 kmph. The train will consist of 8 coaches and have a passenger capacity of 557. The reported speed is 249 kmph. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Lanxess and BPCL Partner for Specialty Lubricant Solutions in India
item.description: Specialty chemicals company LANXESS and Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL) have entered into a partnership to advance specialty lubricant solutions in India. The collaboration aims to leverage LANXESS' global expertise in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: India's Coal Imports Show Mixed Trends in August
item.description: India's coal imports saw a marginal increase for imported fuel-based power plants in August, while overall coal imports declined by 5.83 percent in the same month, indicating a reduced dependence on foreign supplies. The year of the data… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: IGL to Supply Piped Natural Gas to 22 Northern Railway Facilities
item.description: Indraprastha Gas Limited (IGL) has signed an agreement to supply Piped Natural Gas (PNG) to 22 establishments of Northern Railway located across the Delhi-NCR region. This initiative aims to replace the use of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG)… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: India-US trade deal nearing completion, says US envoy
item.description: US Envoy Sergio Gor stated that a trade deal between India and the United States is nearing completion, describing it as being "at the finish line for a long time." He also highlighted strengthening defense ties between the two nations. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: EPFO Launches WhatsApp Service for PF Balance and Passbook Details
item.description: The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) has launched a new service allowing members to check their PF balance and passbook details via WhatsApp. By sending an 'Hi' message, members can receive 'A to Z' details about their… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: India's Oil Imports Reach Record High in October
item.description: India's crude oil imports reached a record high of approximately 5.6 million barrels per day in October. Supplies from the Middle East accounted for around 2.3 million barrels per day, while imports from Russia remained significant at… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Government Plans to Regulate Airline Fare Hikes
item.description: Airlines will not be permitted to arbitrarily increase airfares, according to a plan developed by the government. New rules for flight tickets are set to be implemented from January 1, 2027, which will allow airlines to determine fares. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Indian Bonds May Rise as Oil Falls Amid US Midterm Focus
item.description: India's benchmark 6.94% 2036 bond yield is anticipated to trade within the 7.35%-7.39% range. This potential firming of Indian bonds is linked to a slip in crude oil prices and the upcoming US midterm elections, which are also shaping bond… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Panel Formed to Boost Exporter Relief Scheme
item.description: The Indian government has established a committee to enhance the utilization of the RELIEF (Remission of Duties and Taxes on Export Products) scheme for exporters. The committee aims to improve the uptake of this initiative. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Indian Bank Aims for ₹100 Crore EV Charging Loans by FY27
item.description: Indian Bank plans to lend ₹100 crore under its Electric Vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure scheme by the financial year 2027. The bank's Managing Director, Binod Kumar, stated this target, indicating a significant focus on supporting the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Centre Approves ₹989 Crore for 39 Road Projects in Kerala
item.description: The Union Government has approved ₹989 crore for 39 road development projects in Kerala. The funding will be provided through the Central Road and Infrastructure Fund (CRIF) scheme. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Magnificent Seven AI Debt Climbs 45% to $578 Billion
item.description: SBI Research has reported that the debt of the 'Magnificent Seven' technology companies has surged by 45% to $578 billion. This increase in borrowing is raising concerns about financial vulnerabilities within the technology sector… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Indian Companies Report Strong Q2 Financial Results
item.description: National Securities Depository Limited (NSDL) reported a 10.9% increase in its second-quarter profit, reaching Rs 122.5 crore, with income climbing 34.8%. Central Depository Services Limited (CDSL) saw its profit rise by 24% to ₹173 crore… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: Several Indian companies, including ITC, Marico, UPL, Petronet LNG, NLC, DOMS, Escorts Kubota, NALCO, MobiKwik, and Wockhardt, were scheduled to announce their Q2 financial results on Monday, November 2, 2026. ITC's board of directors met… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Digi Yatra trials expand to international flights at seven airports
item.description: Digi Yatra trials have commenced for select international flights at seven airports across India, including Hyderabad. The initiative aims to streamline passenger processing. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Jio Platforms Lists on Stock Exchange, Stock Rises on Debut
item.description: Jio Platforms debuted on the stock exchange on October 28, opening for trading at ₹1,358, an increase of approximately 21% over its issue price of ₹1,119. By the end of the trading day, the stock had risen 27%, valuing the company at over… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Commercial LPG Prices Rise, GST and Pension Rules Change from November 1
item.description: Effective November 1, 2026, commercial LPG cylinder prices have increased by ₹10, with the new price for a commercial cylinder being ₹2,820. Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF) prices also saw a rise of ₹1.37 per litre. Changes in Goods and… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 7 · Right 2.

item.title: UK Chancellor Unveils Energy Support and Wind Farm Tax Measures
item.description: UK Chancellor John Healey has announced a new energy support package for households, including a £100 one-off payment, loans for low-carbon upgrades, and an end to standing charges. Healey stated this initiative aims to reduce energy costs… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Centre Releases Additional Tax Devolution of ₹1.09 Trillion to States
item.description: The central government has released an additional installment of tax devolution amounting to ₹1.09 trillion to states. This release is intended to accelerate capital spending, particularly ahead of the festive season. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Bank of Baroda Boosts Cyber Security and Plans Overseas Expansion
item.description: Bank of Baroda is increasing its spending on information technology, exceeding 10% of its operating profit, to enhance cyber safeguards. The bank is also planning international expansion, with a focus on wholesale banking in developed… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Alphabet Shares Plunge After Profit Miss and AI Search Impact
item.description: Alphabet, the parent company of Google, experienced a significant drop in market value, losing an estimated $500 billion. This decline followed a disappointing financial report where net profit slid 25% year-on-year to $26.2 billion… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: New Airport Seeks More Flights Amid Airline Capacity Cuts
item.description: Australia's newest airport is seeking to increase flight operations at a time when airlines are reducing their capacity. The specific airport and the extent of the capacity cuts were not detailed in the provided coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: China's Manufacturing Activity Contracts Amid Falling PMI
item.description: China's manufacturing activity experienced its fastest contraction in three months, with the Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) falling to 49.3 in October. This indicates a slowdown in the sector. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: US-Canada Trade Talks Discussed Amidst Election Uncertainty
item.description: Canadian Finance Minister Mark Carney and former US President Donald Trump discussed a potential trade deal between the US and Canada. Carney indicated that Canada could potentially wait for the outcome of the US presidential election… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Global Central Banks May Hike Rates Amid Inflation Concerns
item.description: Several central banks globally are considering further interest rate hikes due to persistent inflation. In the United States, a pickup in job growth may prompt the Federal Reserve to increase rates again. Similarly, Australia's Reserve… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Gold and Silver Prices Plummet, Affecting Market Sentiment
item.description: Gold and silver prices have seen a significant decline, with silver dropping substantially from its record high. One report indicates silver has become cheaper by ₹13,000 per kilogram in a week and is down ₹2.42 lakh per kilogram from its… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Centre and Panchayats to Expand Rural EV Charging Stations
item.description: The Indian central government, through an MoU with CESL, plans to expand access to electric vehicle (EV) charging and battery swapping stations in rural areas. Panchayats will provide land for these charging stations in rural locations… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Meta Ad Revenue Surges Past Google Search Amid AI Reshaping
item.description: Meta's advertising revenue growth has more than doubled that of Google Search, indicating a significant shift in the online advertising market driven by the integration of artificial intelligence. This development suggests that AI is… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Tamil Nadu Allocates Funds for Urban Livelihood Mission and Infrastructure
item.description: The Tamil Nadu government has released Rs 10.7 crore to ensure the continued operation of its urban livelihood mission. Separately, the state announced plans to invest ₹1.50 Lakh Crore in urban infrastructure over the next five years. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Indore Markets See Pre-Dhanteras Boom, Rs 900 Crore Business
item.description: Indore's markets experienced a "mini Dhanatrayodashi" event before the actual festival, with business reaching an estimated Rs 900 crore. The surge in sales spanned from jewelry and precious metals to automobiles, indicating a vibrant… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: SEBI monitoring Tata Sons governance amid leadership and listing discussions
item.description: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) chairman has stated that the market regulator is monitoring developments at Tata Sons, particularly concerning governance, leadership changes, and potential listing plans. The focus is on… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: India Adjusts Export Duties on Fuel Products
item.description: The Indian government has eliminated the export duty on petrol while increasing the windfall tax on exports of diesel and aviation turbine fuel (ATF). This adjustment aims to rebalance domestic supply and international market demands for… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Karnataka CM Announces Milk Price Hike Amid Drought Concerns
item.description: Karnataka Chief Minister Shivakumar has stated that a milk price hike is inevitable to protect farmers, citing drought conditions. This announcement comes as the state faces a broader cost-of-living increase, with milk and bus fares… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
